title: Study finds 0.5-meter spacing between solar module rows improves cooling in floating PV systems
summary: A study by Italian researchers has found that 0.5-meter spacing between module rows optimizes cooling in floating PV systems by improving airflow. The findings highlight the importance of row spacing in thermal management, although further research is needed to assess its impact on electricity generation. The post Study finds 0.5-meter spacing between solar module rows improves cooling in floating PV systems appeared first on pv magazine Global .
